hero.introduction: We support business forums, trade delegations, investor roundtables, exhibitions and market showcases that foster meaningful connections and commercial follow-through.

events.title: AGMEX — Green Mobility & Energy Expo
events.audience: Clean mobility manufacturers, renewable energy financiers, transport ministers, and infrastructure developers.
events.participationOptions: Exhibitor Booths, Country Pavilions, Delegate Passes, Corporate Sponsorship
events.description: Africa's leading platform dedicated to electric mobility, sustainable urban transport, renewable grid technology, and continental supply chains.
events.whoShouldAttend: EV OEMs, battery storage developers, sovereign energy boards, and infrastructure investors.
events.delegationPackage: Curated bilateral B2B meetings, ministerial roundtables, site tours, and targeted networking.

events.title: CAWEE — Market Linkage Program
events.organizer: Center for Accelerated Women's Economic Empowerment (CAWEE)
events.audience: Women entrepreneurs, SME exporters, international retail buyers, and development finance agencies.
events.participationOptions: Buyer Missions, Exhibition Showcases, Mentorship & Export Readiness Sessions
events.description: Connecting 240,000 youth and 6,500 female-led SMEs with verified commercial export corridors across the USA and Middle East.
events.whoShouldAttend: International buyers, ethical retail distributors, impact investors, and development partners.
events.delegationPackage: Pre-screened supplier matching, export documentation guidance, and buyer-seller speed networking.

events.title: Africa Investment Circle — Dubai
events.organizer: Teba Connects in partnership with Regional Institutional Alliances
events.audience: Sovereign wealth managers, GCC family office principals, private equity partners, and vetted project sponsors.
events.participationOptions: By Invitation Only — Limited Delegations & Keynote Roundtables
events.description: Closed-door executive salon matching Gulf institutional capital with bankable infrastructure, energy, and logistics assets across Africa.
events.whoShouldAttend: Accredited institutional investors, sovereign funds, project promoters seeking $25M+ growth capital.
events.delegationPackage: Exclusive access to investment dossiers, 1-on-1 private deal rooms, and senior ministerial dialogue.

eventFormats.title: Bilateral Trade Missions
eventFormats.description: Structured executive missions connecting public-private leadership across the USA, Africa, and GCC.

eventFormats.title: Closed-Door Investor Salons
eventFormats.description: Curated deal presentations directly to accredited institutional allocators and sovereign funds.

eventFormats.title: Exhibition Pavilions
eventFormats.description: Turnkey national and sectoral pavilion curation at premier global expos.

eventFormats.title: Strategic Market Showcases
eventFormats.description: Sector-focused B2B buyer-seller matchmaking forums designed for measurable commercial follow-through.
